title: Office Outdoor Banner
description:
Problem:
Banner ya awali ilikuwa na vitu vingi na ilichosha macho.

Solution:
Nilitengeneza design minimalist yenye white space, icons chache, na ujumbe mfupi ulio wazi.

Tools:
Photoshop.

Impact:
Ujumbe ulieleweka kwa haraka na banner ikaonekana ya kisasa zaidi.
